'''Corellian Technologies''' was an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] manufacturer specializing in personal defense systems.<ref name="GG10" />

Two of the armors they produced included the [[A3AA personal defense module]], which lacked in physical protection but had an emission field which repelled blaster shots, and a [[HuntSuit]], which cost about 2,900 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="GG10" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Corellian Technologies specialized in developing new personal defense systems. To test one such prototype,<ref name="SWG:RPDP" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the engineers attached the system to a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] and sent him into remote wilderness on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Unfortunately, the prototype was not able to protect the droid form wild creatures. A group of freelance spacers was later recruited to hunt the animals and recover the prototype.<ref name="SWG:RPDP" /> During a similar test, the protocol droid carrying the personal defense system prototype was destroyed by some criminals who stole the prototype. In order to prevent industrial espionage, the spacers were then sent to blast the gangster base and destroy the prototype.<ref name="SWG:SPDP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Stolen Personal Defense Prototype}} on Corellia</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Corellian Technologies got contract to build [[Tursturin/Legends|tursturin]]-powered [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlifts]] for a cloud city in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="SWG:TSAbS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Tursturin Supply Attacked by Saboteurs}} on Corellia</ref> However, in 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" />, industrial [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteurs]] tried to steal the company's [[Tursturin/Legends|tursturin]] supplies. As the company did not want to involve local or [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] to avoid questions about the tursturin's provenance, they hired an independent strike team to destroy the saboteurs and their stronghold on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:TSAbS" />

In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> the company was contracted by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to manufacture [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. However, a shipment of [[repulsor-compensator]]s needed in the process was stolen by criminals. The thieves were running a [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking shield]] for their [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ship from a ground station on Corellia. Again, Corellian Technologies recruited independent spacers to deal with the criminals, strike the station and locate the stolen shipment.<ref name="SWG:GbCS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Ground-based Cloaking Shield}} on Corellia</ref>

The same year, Corellian Technologies contracted the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] to eliminate one of its former executive who swindled the company.<ref name="SWG:LD">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal|Bounty Hunter|Fugitive Technology Executive}}</ref>
